Ensuring good relationships between stakeholders, and developing a good understanding of their needs Experienced in Contractual and financial management. Analyzing and benchmarking all Suppliers 's offers dedicated to customer projects Managing and negotiating contractual and pricing aspects with the Suppliers Being the reference point in term of pricing knowledge for stakeholders About You Education : Advanced degree in Business Management or Purchasing or Sales. Experience : Min 5 years in or with Sourcing (sales experience a plus), preferably in B2B, and knowledge of at least one product/technology area Telecom Skills Project Management Strong negotiation skills. Strong interpersonal and relationship skills null Energetic, results-oriented, and proactive with good commercial instincts null Tenacity and perseverance Agile and adaptable mindset You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills. What We Offer Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world. Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working). Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities. Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange. Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events. Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards. Only Your Skills Matter Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. review_candidates.description: Company Description InterConsulta SamAI Egypt is part of a long-established professional services group, originating from Interconsulta, founded in 1964 and trusted by clients across multiple generations. The company provides comprehensive auditing and accounting services, feasibility studies, consolidated financial statement audits, employee pension fund audits, and specialized tests. It also offers extensive business consulting solutions, including succession planning, due diligence, economic calculations, restructuring, and investment assessments. Additional services cover customer and special accounts, payroll accounting, trust transactions, liquidations, inheritance issues, and management mandates. In a fast-changing environment, InterConsulta SamAI Egypt positions itself as a constant, forward-looking partner that evolves with clients while providing reliable, high-quality advisory and financial services. Role Description The Business Development Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities for InterConsulta SamAI Egypt. Day-to-day tasks include conducting market research, analyzing trends, and generating qualified leads in target sectors and regions. The role involves building and maintaining relationships with prospective and existing clients, coordinating online meetings and presentations, and collaborating with internal teams to tailor service offerings to client needs. The specialist will prepare proposals, support pricing and negotiation processes, and track business development activities in CRM tools. The role also requires regular reporting on pipeline performance, contributing to growth strategies, and representing the company in virtual events and digital channels. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret market data, financial information, and business performance indicators. Candidates should possess excellent communication skills, with clear written and verbal communication and the ability to present complex services to diverse stakeholders. Candidates should possess proven lead generation abilities, including prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and managing a sales pipeline. Candidates should possess solid market research skills, including competitor analysis and sector-specific research within professional services or financial consulting. Candidates should possess customer service skills, demonstrating client-focused behavior, responsiveness, and long-term relationship building. Experience in business development, sales, or account management within consulting, auditing, or financial services is highly beneficial. Familiarity with CRM systems, digital outreach tools, and remote collaboration platforms is preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage priorities, and meet targets and deadlines.

review_candidates.title: Localization Web Developer
review_candidates.description: Description About the Role We are looking for a Front-end Localization Engineer to join our UI engineering team and play a key role in delivering high-quality, localized user experiences across our SaaS platform. Blend your strong front-end engineering expertise; React and modern web technologies, with hands-on localization engineering. You will enjoy building scalable interfaces while shaping how products reach a global audience. Create user interfaces that work seamlessly across languages and regions. Help design, build, and evolve our localization processes to ensure internationalization is embedded into the front-end from the start. Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA , CO , CT , FL , GA , *IL , KS , MA , MD, ME , NJ , NC , NY , OH, OR , TN , TX , VA , and WA . We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. Onsite interviews may be required for this role. What You’ll Be Doing Front-end & Localization Engineering: Apply your front-end engineering expertise to design, implement, and maintain scalable internationalized UI solutions. Work directly in the codebase to integrate localization into React components, manage localization files, and make UI and architectural adjustments that preserve performance, accessibility, and translation quality. Continuously evaluate and adopt tools and technologies that improve localization workflows, scalability, and developer experience. UI Localization Implementation & QA: Extract and manage new or updated UI strings, coordinate translation efforts with internal teams and external vendors, respond to translator questions, and ensure translations are correctly implemented in the front-end. Validate localized builds across languages and regions, support localization QA and bug reporting processes, and partner with engineers and designers to resolve UI, layout, and functional issues related to localization. Cross-functional Localization Ownership: Serve as a key front-end–focused point of contact for localization across the product, with a strong emphasis on international customer experience. Independently identify, investigate, and resolve localization and internationalization issues throughout the UI. Manage localization readiness for each product release and act as a technical bridge between Front-end Engineering, Localization, Design, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear, effective communication and smooth delivery of localized features. Other Duties as needed. About You Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science or Engineering. 3+ years of professional experience in front-end or software engineering roles. 2+ years working with React, JavaScript, and CSS. Localization engineering experience including internationalization, localization, adaptive UI, and responsive design principles. You are Bilingual, with strong verbal and written communication skills in English and at least one additional language. Experience building component-based, reusable UI components, using design systems and tools such as Figma and Storybook or others. Working knowledge of Python, including basic automation scripting or development workflows. Experience with localization-related workflows, including Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools. Familiarity with front-end testing frameworks and an understanding of how and why to write effective test cases. Strong collaborator who can effectively bridge diverse teams across cultures and facilitate seamless cross-departmental cooperation. Highly self-sufficient and proactive, comfortable independently managing projects from start to finish. Experience working in a fast-paced environment and can effectively prioritize tasks and projects. About Us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for more than 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. What You’ll Love Our flexible working hours with home office options enable you to successfully balance your personal life and your job. Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally. Develop your skills through our renowned training platform. Receive competitive compensation. Collaborate with an amazing international workforce. Additional Information This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship. Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $65,000 to $100,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $65,000 to $100,000 per year. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment. Onsite interviews maybe required for this role.

review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer (Networking) - Platform Infra
review_candidates.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join Platform Infrastructure - Application Networking and set where Elastic Cloud application networking goes next. This work covers Ingress, security controls, private connectivity, and DNS management — the path every interaction with Elasticsearch, Kibana, and the broader Elastic stack takes. You will drive the technical vision, architecture, and design of these systems, not just execute against an existing roadmap. This is a Principal-level role for an engineer who has designed high-performance, scalable networking platforms and can drive technical initiatives across organizations. Elastic is investing in the reliability, security, and reach of Elastic Cloud; you will hold a high bar for those qualities while other engineering teams rely on what this platform provides. What You Will Be Doing: Set the technical direction for major application networking initiatives, owning designs from proposal through general availability. Lead the development of Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls on a large scale for Elastic Cloud. Continuously identify and address issues related to performance, reliability, and operability. Lead multi-quarter, cross-organizational projects that other Elastic engineering teams rely on, and guide these projects through to delivery. Raise the operational quality of our services. Take charge of operational investigations from beginning to end. Lead complex incident investigations and reviews. Participate in on-call rotation. Mentor and support engineers across the team, serve as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor to the wider engineering organization, and set the standard for how we build software. Partner with and advise product management and senior engineering stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and roadmap direction. Identify and champion improvements to security, stability, and cost efficiency before they become problems. Untangle complexity and bring architectural clarity across the platform. What You Bring: Experience with building software, including setting technical direction for complex distributed systems running production at scale (Staff or Principal level, or equivalent scope). Deep expertise in application networking and cloud-native architecture. You should understand how services communicate at scale. Knowledge of how to design, operate, and evolve Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls is required. You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services. You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components. You have experience guiding work involving multiple engineers. You have operated high-availability SaaS platforms, responded to incidents, and improved reliability over time. You care about the quality of work shipped — testing, observability, and operability. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication. You communicate clearly and can influence direction across teams and levels without formal authority. Bonus Points: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking (Cilium, external-dns, Envoy Gateway, and Crossplane) and with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its networking ecosystem. You have contributed to CNCF or other open-source networking projects Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People: As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary Health coverage for you and your family in many locations Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles Generous number of vacation days each year Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience. Different people approach problems differently. We need that. review_candidates.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth. As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. Guide junior team members to support your endeavors Monitor external dependencies and alternatives to assess potential issues or improvements Influence, nurture and grow our engineering culture Contribute upstream to open source software projects to close gaps in required functionality Engage in the robotics scene to stay up to date with ongoing developments and share knowledge in and outside of our company What we're looking for Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 7+ years of hands-on experience in Software Engineering, Robotics Development or similar roles Strong Software Engineering skills and solid experience with related tooling (e.g. clangd, cargo, pyrefly) Strong programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have Track record of leading high impact projects across teams Experience with middleware (iceoryx2, DDS, AUTOSAR Adaptive) and IDLs (FlatBuffers, Protobuf) Bonus Qualifications Don't meet every requirement?
